cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:2a.title: Installer Technician - Commercial/Residential
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:2a.description: Position Summary The Commercial/Residential Installer Technician plays a critical role in turning sold work into completed, high-quality installations that drive revenue, customer satisfaction, and long-term reliability. This position is responsible for completing residential and commercial installations safely, efficiently, and according to quality standards. Responsibilities include loading the correct materials, installing garage doors and operators, following job documentation and installation instructions, and completing all required job checklists. The Installer Technician directly impacts installation quality, schedule performance, safety, and the organization's ability to complete work correctly the first time. Key Responsibilities Installation Execution Install residential and commercial garage doors, overhead doors, rolling steel doors, and electric operators. Perform installation tasks including mounting track, winding springs, installing hardware, assembling door sections, and installing trim. Read and follow job documentation and installation instructions accurately. Complete installations in accordance with quality and safety standards. Material & Job Preparation Review work orders and load the correct materials for each assigned job. Verify that all required tools, hardware, and door components are available before leaving for the jobsite. Help prevent installation delays and errors by ensuring proper preparation. Handle materials carefully during loading, transportation, and installation. Tool & Equipment Operation Safely operate hand and power tools including drills, impact drivers, saws, wrenches, sockets, screwdrivers, hammers, chisels, and other installation equipment. Read a tape measure accurately. Follow safe operating procedures for all tools and equipment. Read wiring diagrams and assist with operator installations when required. Physical Work & Jobsite Readiness Perform physically demanding installation work, including lifting heavy materials. Work on ladders, lifts, and elevated surfaces as required. Adapt to both residential and commercial installation environments. Follow supervisor instructions and contribute to efficient jobsite operations. Documentation, Safety & Professionalism Complete required pre-installation and post-installation checklists. Follow all personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements and safety procedures. Maintain dependable attendance and arrive prepared for each workday. Represent the organization professionally while working at customer locations.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:54582ba1-dac7-.title: Records Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:54582ba1-dac7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Records Manager based in Ireland. This is a flexible, fractional opportunity for an experienced records, compliance, or information governance professional to establish and manage a controlled archive and knowledge-review system. You will play a critical role in determining what information should be preserved, how records are tracked, and what material is ready for entry into a governed knowledge environment. The role combines meticulous records management with responsible use of approved AI tools to accelerate classification and inventory processes. Your judgment will remain central, with every significant AI-assisted decision requiring human verification and careful review. You will work independently, identify risks early, and ensure sensitive information is handled with exceptional discretion. This position is particularly suited to someone who values accuracy, accountability, and strong information governance practices. The engagement is structured as an 8-week pilot with up to 8 hours per week, offering meaningful work without a full-time commitment. Receive, preserve, organize, and track the custody of authorized records and source files throughout the review and archival process. Review incoming information for sensitivity, ownership, completeness, and eligibility for admission into the governed knowledge environment. Use approved AI tools to accelerate information inventory, classification, and review while personally validating all material decisions before they are finalized. Identify and immediately escalate missing, corrupted, incomplete, sensitive, or otherwise high-risk records. Maintain accurate tracking of records, review decisions, outstanding items, and relevant risks. Apply sound professional judgment when determining whether information is suitable for preservation or further review. Provide a concise weekly report covering completed work, remaining backlog, key decisions, and identified risks. Help establish reliable processes and controls for a new or evolving records and knowledge-governance function. Escalate uncertainty or ambiguity rather than making unsupported assumptions, ensuring information is handled consistently and responsibly. Requirements Professional experience in records management, information governance, compliance, audit, legal operations, or a closely related field. Exceptional discretion and demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential or sensitive information responsibly. Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy, documentation, and records integrity. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and capable of identifying errors, limitations, or inappropriate recommendations produced by AI. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions, summarize findings, and communicate risks clearly. Sound judgment and a disciplined approach to escalating uncertainty, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns. Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities effectively within a limited-hours engagement. Experience establishing an archive, records-management process, or governance function from the ground up is a plus. Familiarity with legal holds, privacy requirements, cybersecurity practices, or related information governance controls is advantageous. Experience designing human-review controls or quality-assurance processes for AI-assisted workflows is a bonus. A mindset focused on accountability, precision, and preventing unverified information from becoming part of an official knowledge environment. Benefits Fractional contract engagement of up to 8 hours per week. 8-week pilot engagement. Flexible work-from-anywhere arrangement. HMO health insurance. Paid time off. Opportunities for promotion. Potential for pay increases. Opportunity to contribute to the development of a new records and knowled

jobgether-jobgether:lever:6a954bcd-76ca-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Legal Manager (Freelance) based in India. This role offers an opportunity for an experienced legal professional to take ownership of key legal activities within a growing, technology-driven organization. You will help ensure that business operations remain compliant with applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations. The position combines legal management, strategic advisory work, risk assessment, and cross-functional collaboration. You will provide practical guidance to leadership while helping the organization navigate corporate and operational legal matters. The role requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear business recommendations. Strong background in corporate law and experience advising organizations on a range of business-related legal matters. Solid understanding of applicable legal and regulatory frameworks, with the ability to identify and address compliance risks. Experience reviewing and drafting contracts, agreements, policies, and other corporate legal documents. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple legal matters and competing priorities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong professional judgment, discretion, and integrity when handling sensitive legal and business matters. Ability to work independently and effectively as a freelance professional in a flexible, remote environment. Relevant legal qualifications and authorization to practice law in the applicable jurisdiction. Benefits Freelance engagement with a flexible, part-time structure. Remote working arrangement. Opportunity to take ownership of important legal and compliance activities. Strategic exposure to a growing, technology-driven marketplace. Ability to work closely with leadership and contribute to business-level decision-making. Flexible environment suited to experienced legal professionals seeking autonomy. Opportunity to apply corporate legal expertise to innovative, globally oriented business operations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b86c008d-da66-.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b86c008d-da66-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Germany. This is an opportunity to develop AI and machine learning solutions that support the personalization of digital therapies and improve patient outcomes. You’ll work with longitudinal real-world health data to build models that can predict risks and enable more adaptive approaches to care. The role spans the full ML lifecycle, from data pipelines and model development through validation, deployment, and production integration. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and multidisciplinary teams to translate advanced models into reliable digital health products. A strong focus on explainability, reproducibility, privacy, and regulatory requirements makes this a technically rigorous environment. You’ll also have the opportunity to explore generative AI applications for patient education and digital coaching. This is a high-impact role for an experienced ML professional who wants to apply AI to meaningful healthcare challenges.

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:027079.title: Product Designer
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:027079.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. Design is foundational to our product and our company. As a Product Designer at Profound, you will work on our core data visualization and content workflow tools. This is an opportunity to have deep ownership over our product and ship fast and ship often, while continuing to craft the experience for our users. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Design core product experiences end to end, from early exploration through launch and iteration - Work closely with product managers and engineers to translate strategy and ambiguous problems into clear, thoughtful solutions - Explore multiple directions quickly through sketches, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs - Sweat the details and fine tune layout shifts, typography, spacing, motion, and interactions - Balance building good product focused on user needs, technical constraints, and business goals while keeping a high bar for craft - Use user feedback, qualitative insights, and product intuition to refine and improve the product over time - Contribute to and help evolve Profound’s design language, systems, and product vision - Participate in Tuesday and Thursday design critiques to give and receive feedback on in-progress design work WHO YOU ARE - You have 3 or more years of experience designing digital products, ideally in a startup or fast-moving product company - You are a strong generalist with taste and are comfortable owning the full stack of design assets, from flows to pixels to final product - You care deeply about craft and believe great design is defined by clarity, simplicity, and execution - You bring an entrepreneurial and product-thinking mindset to design - You like to experiment with AI, new tools, and ways of working, whether through new Figma plugins or tools such as v0, Cursor, or other prototyping tools - You are good at collaborating with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to solve problems - You have a portfolio that shows thoughtful problem-solving and high-quality visual design - Experience working on a data visualization or B2B marketing product - Enjoy prototyping directly in code and shipping directly to production using git and GitHub - Blur the lines between where design ends and product or engineering work begins - You can just do things NOTE FROM OUR CO-FOUNDER In the evolving landscape of product development, exceptional design is not merely a nice-to-have, it is foundational. As software engineering becomes increasingly accessible, it is taste, creativity, and thoughtful execution that differentiate outstanding products from the rest. I believe deeply that design sits at the core of our success. At Profound, my goal is to build a design team renowned for setting a new standard of excellence, crafting experiences so compelling they become benchmarks in our industry. If you are someone who believes in the transformative power of great design and wants to create work that genuinely shapes the future, join us. Let’s redefine what’s possible together. Dylan Babbs, Co-founder & CTO LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our NYC, SF or Buenos Aires office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For

titanwh-titanwh:lever:ba376be9-1ec1-4be8.description: The Titan Group provides a broad range of services across the whole wealth value chain – from financial planning, investment management through to platform, trading, settlement and custody services. Its strategy is to be able to offer modular, incremental services to its clients allowing them to adjust their business models as and when they choose to. As part of this Titan is also an active acquirer of UK based asset managers and other wealth related businesses. Due to this Titan Wealth is expanding rapidly through strategic acquisitions, offering a unique combination of start-up energy and the security of private equity backing. It’s an inspiring time to join the team! Titan Wealth Planning (TWP) is a subsidiary of Titan Wealth. Our focus is providing best-in-class advice on wealth management, employee benefits, and retirement planning. Our mission is to help businesses and their employees explore, set, and achieve their financial goals. We are interested in speaking with individuals based in the West Midlands for this position - but we will look at candidates who wish to work remote. The main purpose of this role is research and write advice reports, support training and development of the team, and to take an active role in maintaining paraplanning tools and reference material.
responsibilities: To draft suitability reports with guidance from the Financial Planner, in accordance with all compliance and departmental requirements.
To liaise with the Financial Planners to ensure all information received is complete and accurate for advice to be given.
Assist in the interpretation of the adviser’s client meeting and prepare suitable recommendations with a high level of accuracy and care.
Provide guidance to advisers on aspects of specific cases to support good consumer outcomes.
To ensure that the customer experience follows the Group’s defined standards and TCF is always maintained.
To ensure that all relevant research, client support and Compliance and Systems processes are always observed to maintain excellent data quality and compliant performance in the job role.
Update workflow records to facilitate the production of accurate management information in a timely manner.
Manage workloads as required and liaise with Line Manager to highlight over/under capacity. Ensuring relevant workflows are kept up to date to accurately reflect workflow.
Follow and promote best practice for all adviser support and client facing processes, ensuring consistent process and output quality.
Ensure effective communication with CS, advisers, and other colleagues to ensure a great customer experience.
To run own case load efficiently and keep all own case records and files up to date and to departmental required standards.
To obtain data for existing policies/schemes of clients and analyse/research the information provided, using various software programs as appropriate.
To obtain illustrations and Key Features documentation in support of recommendations to clients.
Ensure technical knowledge and general industry knowledge is always maintained.
Providing coaching, mentoring, or training support for Paraplanners
Being a model of excellence and Group process adherence
Proactively identify opportunities to improve paraplanning process
